# Optimus Brain — public snapshot (English)
# built 2026-07-11 17:21 UTC · brain @ 5e712e5

This host is a read-only export of the Optimus memory layer
behind Aegis Finance. Machine endpoints:

  /brain.json      full public snapshot (stats + graph + pages + demos)
  /pages/<id>.md   raw public knowledge pages:

    /pages/aegis-finance-decisions.md  — Aegis Finance — Decisions
    /pages/aegis-finance-history.md  — Aegis Finance — Commit History
    /pages/aegis-finance-overview.md  — Aegis Finance — Overview
    /pages/aegis-finance-structure.md  — Aegis Finance — Structure
    /pages/aegis-quant-knowledge-overview.md  — KNOWLEDGE — Overview
    /pages/aegis-quant-knowledge-structure.md  — KNOWLEDGE — Structure

Private content (identity, dispositions, personal projects)
is excluded by construction — anonymized graph nodes and
aggregate counts only.
